evidence.quote: The adjusted bonuses remain in effect until the start of your next turn.

overrideReason: Rebuild from full English rules; correct Divine Word timing and unsafe global AC-transfer effects, preserve carried benefits and daily spells, and identify every weapon, curse, artifact and sentience boundary.
notes: Partial: attunement is required. The longsword has +3 attack/damage, criticals on natural 19 or 20, and +2d10 Slashing only against Undead. While carried, it grants +1d10 Initiative and Necrotic resistance; those benefits remain deferred pending carried-item binding. On an action to attack with this sword, choose 0-3 of its attack bonus to move to AC until the start of the next turn; this changes the sword's attack bonus, not all melee attacks or damage. If no blood reaches the drawn blade in 1 minute, the wielder makes CHA DC 15: success deals 3d6 Psychic to the wielder, failure gives sword-directed Dominate Monster until its demand for blood is met. Call Lightning, Divine Word and Finger of Death each have a separate once-per-dawn use and DC 18; normal casting times are action, Bonus Action and action. Four artifact properties are separately rolled: one minor/major beneficial and one minor/major detrimental. The sword itself is Chaotic Evil, INT 15/WIS 13/CHA 16, hears and has 120-ft Darkvision, speaks Common and communicates telepathically with its wielder; these are not wielder grants. Destruction requires the caster's attunement to both Vecna artifacts, their combined Wish, the sword within 30 ft, and CHA DC 18 success; failure wastes Wish.

evidence.quote: The staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff.

overrideReason: The English body supplies on-hit charge consumption, full damage, target-only one-hour disadvantage and class-restricted attunement; the Foundry target effect must not transfer to the wearer.
notes: Partial: a 4-lb simple magic Quarterstaff, 1d6 Bludgeoning or 1d8 with two hands, requiring attunement by a cleric, druid or warlock. It has 3 charges and restores 1d3 expended charges at dawn, capped at 3. On a hit, optionally spend 1 charge for +2d10 Necrotic against the same target and CON DC 15; the damage occurs regardless of the save, while failure imposes disadvantage on STR/CON checks and saves for 1 hour. The Withered effect belongs to the struck target, never the wielder. Topple is a separate feature-gated mastery save, not the DC-15 withering save.

overrideReason: Expand the actual XDMG itemEntry template before annotation; its Undead barrier, movement termination and creature-specific bypass are executable mechanics requiring deferred settlement.
